tests.name: run/forget guards on a live run
tests.covers: 416 carries Content-Range */len; POST /api/run with a phone host and no --lan → 422 and the current run stays ready; DELETE /api/devices/{id} on a run member → run error 'was forgotten', device removed
tests.evidence: PASS 04:53 IST (round-11 build, run-guards.sh ALL OK, 32 checks): refusals (--lan, n_ctx, unknown model, 8B shortfall) 422 with the run still ready and the plan_id read BEFORE the request unchanged and non-null; replacement path with the laptop MEASURED: immediate re-run during loading → credited=[]; after ready the ctx-4096 re-run credited local 293,187,584 B == RssAnon+RssShmem of the llama-server read independently from /proc (placement 868,376,576 B); D024 premise measured: ctx-8192 laptop-alone run credited 997,859,328 B and the stop released 1,133,116,416 B of MemAvailable (avg of 3 samples each side; within the 30 % tolerance, and in the safe direction — more released than credited); forget member → error, device removed. Not shown on hardware: the phone's held_bytes path and a case where the credit flips the planner's answer (unit tests only)
